entries.sourceText:
A. I am Li Wei. I am a student. This is my first day at the language school. I am from Shanghai. I am in Class A.

B. This is Ms. Chen. She is my teacher. She is from Beijing. She is very kind. She says, "Hello, Li Wei. You are in my class. I am your teacher."

C. I say, "Hello, Ms. Chen. I am happy. You are a good teacher." Ms. Chen says, "Thank you. You are a good student. Goodbye!"

questions.prompt: Which word does Ms. Chen use to say farewell to Li Wei? Write one word from the text.

entries.sourceText:
A. I am Lin. I am a new student. I am at the Green Leaf English Club. It is Monday morning.

B. I see a woman. I say, "Hello. I am Lin." She says, "Hello, Lin. I am Anna. I am a teacher here." I say, "You are my teacher. Thank you."

C. Anna says, "You are a student. I am a teacher. We are a team." I am happy. I say, "You are very kind." Anna says, "You are ready. Good luck!"

questions.prompt: In Part A, what does Lin say about being a learner?
What does Lin say when first speaking to Anna in Part B?
